rationale: The agent submitted a return request without first confirming the action with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, the agent did not address the user’s request to know how many t-shirt options are available, nor did it show any tool use that would produce that count or provide a handoff if unavailable. While minimal authentication appears to have been attempted (finding the user by name and zip) and the return seems tied to a user order, the missing confirmation and incomplete fulfillment of the t-shirt inquiry mean the request was not completed in line with policy. The final claim about refunding to a specific Mastercard ending in 2478 is also not clearly supported by visible tool outputs.
